name: openshortlink
description: OpenShort.link - Open-source Cloudflare-based link shortener and management platform

scripts.deploy:preview: npm run db:migrate:preview && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.preview.toml
scripts.deploy:production-stage: npm run verify && npm run db:migrate:production-stage && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.production-stage.toml
scripts.deploy:production: npm run verify && npm run db:migrate:production && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.toml
scripts.db:migrate:preview: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.preview.toml
scripts.db:migrate:production-stage: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.production-stage.toml
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.toml
scripts.verify: npm test -- --run && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:mcp

SETUP_TOKEN.description: Security token for first user setup. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32` for production, or use a strong password (20+ chars) for personal use.

CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Your [Cloudflare Account ID](https://dash.cloudflare.com/) - found in the dashboard URL or right sidebar.

CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.description: API token with **Account Analytics Read** permission. [Create one here](https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens).
